pastJobsText.title: Mailchimp Set up and Management
pastJobsText.description: I am requiring support for the setup of a Mailchimp and a small amount of ongoing reporting. A small brief - We have 5500 contacts that we want to set into 8-12 segments (note that we dont require Zapier etc to be set up as this will only be to market to colder leads) - We want to do A/B testing - We want someone who can support with the design side (AI is fine) - Ongoing reporting of what is working / what isn't so that we can adjust The account is set up, we have full data and a basic design

pastJobsText.title: Finance Model for Technology Consulting business
pastJobsText.description: I want to create a finance model for a Technology Consulting business. The business wins work on fixed quotes associated with hourly rate items and I want a finance model that can - Project Future Profit and Loss (including as variables change such as onboarding new staff, utilisation) - Map and Manage Pipeline and workflow - Track profitability (eg what we quoted in hours vs what we completed in hours) I want someone that has done this before and ideally is 1. Replicating a SIMPLE but proven model 2. Scenario planning - allows all key variables to be adjusted to work with different scenarios (eg if charge out rate changes, utilisation) 2. On google sheets that I can then white label.

pastJobsText.title: Virtual Assistant - Google Proficient, Xero, Design
pastJobsText.description: We run a Business Coaching business in Australia. We need a VA to support with a number of general tasks including - General research (such as researching on the web for a competitor analysis) - Google sheets - creating and maintaining google sheets - Google slides - creating presentations based off a brief - Xero experience- reviewing monthly performance and creating dashboards. - Graphic design skills would be advantageous but not required We are looking for someone with good attention for detail and strong comprehension. This will not be a client facing role. We anticipate the hours will be 5-15 per week with the possibility to grow.

pastJobsText.title: Market Research / Competitor Review
pastJobsText.description: We need a market research task done for a client. This involves assessing the competitive landscape for a Vehicle wrapping business based in Australia. We have 15 criteria that we want assessed across 10 different suppliers. It will be a desktop audit with no calling required. Good communication skills are required. Work will need to be complete within 5 days. Attached is the example of the work with 2 businesses partially complete. We require the work to be done and then presented in a way that can be delivered to a client (professional)

pastJobsText.title: Omnisend Email Marketing
pastJobsText.description: We are looking for two tasks 1. To set up our first email marketing campaign using Omnisend. We have a series of basic emails created and have a database of 200 cold leads that we want to start sending that email sequence to. We need advice on how to make the emails as attractive to open and convert as possible and ensure they do not go to spam. 2. We would also like support on how to automate leads going from our lead source (Bark.com) to omnisend
